title: Gideon and the Winter
author: Odile Winterbourne
blurb: Casper Zhou, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
